protocol.reference: Local matched reevaluation of the released checkpoint
protocol.uncertainty: Not plotted: each bar is an aggregate success rate on one shared task list, not a mean across independent training runs
protocol.data_augmentation_definition: Interaction-biased collection using action bias, noise and the documented collection/filtering recipe; not image-only augmentation.

interpretation: Training-data and planning changes improve both frozen and adaptive control settings; these are not distinct model architectures or matched comparisons against other world-model families.
